answer: Every answer posts a deposit of 150,000 POA from its own key. The protocol burns 60,000 at once, whatever the verdict, and burns the other 90,000 too if the jury median is below 2 or the text copies an earlier answer. The burn exceeds the 45,000 POA floor payout, so each identity nets at most -15,000 POA per epoch, and 1,000 fakes burn 60 million per epoch even when every answer passes. Deposits cannot be pooled, shared or lent, so cost grows linearly with n. A relic of fresh keys, a haven of bought wallets or a dawn of idle accounts pays the same.
